completion_binding.assignment: Exact original earlier A02 event plus actual selected Government engagement.
completion_binding.execution_feedback: Own final task, A04/A07 sources/audits and actual native project_completed/quality_issue; no invented event recipient or delivered receipt.
completion_binding.outcome: Keep micro accepted opinion distinct from native completed/rectification_required; the original defect gate can require rectification even when micro approves.
completion_binding.procedure_identity: A separately identified case checklist links source_procedure_ref to the exact unchanged procedure of the original received submission and case. Never overwrite an intake procedure version with another case or tick-specific checklist.
completion_binding.limits: Document review only; no GOV-A10 physical inspection coverage, formal permit or second ledger.

saved_result_recovery.observed: A controlled micro journal interruption at tick 3, after original GOV-A07 result persistence, is reconciled once while the original macro call remains open. Original result/audit is unchanged. Macro records actual rectification, another project completes; tick 4 original GOV-A12 reads both earlier outcomes and its original result is consumed by A04/A07. saved_result_recovery.checks: Same current original native request, organization/project/time, pinned sources, original invocation, all execution versions, saved completed results and audits. Includes original A12 stage when configured; acquires host guard before client lock.
saved_result_recovery.limits: Manual recover_proposal only queries and returns the original response without delivery. The optional same-call policy returns that response to the still-waiting original macro proposal, not a new submission. Never execute an absent stage, replay a processor/model, create a new native request, restore an engine, advance a clock or resubmit business. Unknown/stale work remains unresolved. existing_bridge.source_boundary: Current selected agency requires its actual accepted A02 event, original proposal/final and micro result. existing_bridge.review_handoff: Original A04 recomputes its disclosed saved rule execution. Actual completed review checks, original source versions, author/grant and per-project method descriptors form private A07 assessment/finding projections; no formal assessment registration.
existing_bridge.native_semantics: Explicit outcome policy selects an independently authorized approval rule if all checks conform; an actual nonconforming check selects a no-permission defer_by_procedure draft requiring revision. Original A07 independently validates the draft. approve maps to native approve; defer_by_procedure maps to request_revision. Final transport checks the same original result and bounded request, without redecision.
existing_bridge.feedback_consumer: Actual approval_approved/approval_rejected is projected only to the responsible agency. Later original A04/A07 source views read strictly earlier own outcomes authenticated to original micro sources/audits, proposal, final and native event. History remains context; it does not change independent jurisdiction or conformity facts.
existing_bridge.limits: Development sources are explicitly synthetic document-code checks, not physical design compliance or real legal validity. No initial case is created by intake, no signed decision ID, delivery or detailed permit is fabricated. Conditional approval and formal refusal are not request_revision. Unknown/unresolved review, other A04/A07 branches, formal filing, delivery, permits, other regulator actions and recovery remain pending.

Mobilization and detailed delivery remain pending. Later A04 reuses the native wire request ID at a distinct original tick-scoped task. shared_assembly.routing: Explicit disjoint proposal/final ownership; both original receipt dispatchers retain recipient isolation. All handlers are installed before any application seals its immutable client implementation.
shared_assembly.contract_terms_observed: Seven declared initial projects; three ticks, 62 original micro results across eight roles and 208 formed technical tasks. The first terms project is signed by the native lifecycle at tick 3; the followup consumes actual earlier own A04 posture and requests revision without signing. Later OWN-A03 decisions read one then two actual earlier own payment requests. Six applications share one authority and journal.

The three-tick bundle declares a first-tick opportunity target while preserving two additional active-project slots; input-provenance.json records the initial values. shared_assembly.payment_feedback_observed: Five explicit initial cases and the same five shared applications complete two ticks with 56 original micro results. All four later original OWN-A03 decisions consume one strictly earlier actual own progress-payment request and reject under the explicit request-count preference; the supplied initiation-count limit 999 is not reached. Native approved status is not cash execution.
shared_assembly.observed: Two native ticks, 56 original micro action results across all eight roles, actual PGEN0001 creation/financing/appointment and transition to design; later Owner opportunity uses its prior actual creation.
shared_assembly.limits: Assembly evidence alone does not prove execution, feedback consumption or full lifecycle coverage. Optional approval and contract-preparation cases are explicit initial assumptions, not generated project history or evidence of completed micro design, tender, signature or finance execution.
